note: Encounter type vocabulary. Four real settings plus Not Available. Scored per page; the answer belongs to the DOCUMENT, so page scores are pooled over the document before a label is given. 'strong' phrases are worth 3, 'weak' 1, and a strong phrase in the top header band is worth 5. Negatives cancel their own class only.
default_comment: Client instruction: an outpatient encounter with no modality statement defaults to Evisit. Applied as an explicit rule after scoring, never learned, so it stays auditable.

weak: patient at home during the call

strong: plan of treatment for home health
skilled nursing visit in the home
this report is not a visit note

document_type_priors._comment: Page type is stronger evidence than any phrase for some documents. Applied before the lexicon; the lexicon then only has to settle the outpatient modality.
document_type_priors._comment_exceptions: An Operative Note from an ambulatory surgery centre is outpatient, and a Patient Communication page can be the only record of an evisit. Both are overridden by a strong lexicon hit, which is why the prior is a starting point and not a decision.

_comment_weak_terms_removed: Removed on first run because they fire on unrelated text: 'floor' matched 'pelvic floor laxity', 'unit' and 'units' match every lab result line, and a bare 'phone' appears in every patient banner. A weak term that fires everywhere is worse than no term, because it shifts every page by the same amount and only adds noise to the margin.
_comment_word_boundaries: All matching is whole-phrase with word boundaries. On the first run substring matching put 150 outpatient pages into Inpatient, because 'icu' is inside 'difficulty' and 'diverticulosis'.
_comment_2026_10_24: Prior key 'Lab Report/Result' renamed to 'Lab Report' to match taxonomy_v29 L1. With the old key the prior never fired on current data, and about 290 lab pages fell to 'no evidence'.

patient_type_field.page_rule: A page that carries the field takes its value when the page was suggested a different setting (Inpatient or an Outpatient class). Not Available pages (labs, consents) keep Not Available.
patient_type_field.chart_rule: When a Demographics page (face sheet, registration) in a chart carries the field and no page in that chart carries a different value, the chart suggestion is that value, and every page in the chart suggested Inpatient flips to Outpatient (F2F) when the field says outpatient or ambulatory.
patient_type_field.comment: Client approved 2026-10-24. An explicit patient-type field outranks phrases such as "admission date", which hospital headers print on outpatient procedure records too (Chart 15: outpatient colonoscopy, 20 pages had been suggested Inpatient).

_comment_asc_2026_10_24: Client direction 2026-10-24: ambulatory surgery centre wording is a strong Outpatient (F2F) hit, so it overrides the Operative Note prior (Inpatient).
